Name: (AT)(CP) Pixie's MCM Bedroom Furniture
Author: caterpixies
Description:
[font=Georgia][font=Georgia][b][b][font=Georgia][b][b][b][b][center]--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/center][/b][/b][/b][/b][/font][/b][/b][/font][/font][center]
A collection of bedroom furniture in a mid-century modern style! All items come in a light, medium and dark wood tone (which correspond to birch, oak and walnut in the Alternative Textures version).

As for the beds, those come in 5 swatches each, for a total of 15 beds options! (I MIGHT plan on adding more but I don't want the catalogue to be overrun with beds)


[font=Georgia][size=4][b]How to Use:[/b][/size][/font]

[font=Georgia][size=3][u]Content Patcher ver.[/u][/size][/font]
[font=Georgia][size=3]1. Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36735]the catalogue[/url]﻿, Calcifer and Content Patcher
2. [b]In game[/b]: purchase the catalogue from [b]Robin's Shop

[/b][font=Georgia][size=3][u]Alternative Textures ver.[/u][/size][/font][/size]
[size=3]1. Download Alternative Textures
2. [b]In game: [/b]Purchase the [b]paint bucket[/b] from Robin's shop
3. Use the paint bucket on the corresponding furniture to change the textures. (there's a reference image in the files)

[size=4][b]FAQ:[/b][/size][size=3][b]

[u][/u][/b][/size][size=3][b][u] When is the rest of the collection coming out?[/u][/b]
Honestly, I’m working full-time and going to school, so this is kind of just a hobby for me. I'm also really anal about how I want everything to look, so it takes me a bit of time. But I’m definitely working on it and I’ll  release stuff as it’s ready!

[b][u]Q: What’s next on the roadmap?[/u][/b]
[/size]I'm wanting to make this collection as modular as possible, so with that in mind I want to make a separate painting/decoration/clutter pack which might be next! Or I also want to work on living room stuff, so whichever inspires me more tbh.
